name: ConfigCat SDK for Node.js
solves: Provides a Node.js SDK client for the ConfigCat hosted feature flag and configuration management service, enabling remote feature toggling with user targeting, percentage rollouts, and multiple polling strategies without requiring self-hosted infrastructure.
best_for: Teams wanting a hosted feature flag service that is simpler and cheaper than LaunchDarkly
Node.js backend services needing user-targeted feature flags with auto-polling, lazy loading, or manual polling modes
Applications requiring remote feature flag management via a dashboard without self-hosting any infrastructure
Projects needing custom caching strategies (e.g., Redis) for feature flag configuration data
Express or Node.js APIs that need real-time feature flag updates via webhooks or PubNub integration
skip_when: You need a self-hosted or open-source feature flag solution with no external service dependency
You want a free, unlimited feature flag system for a large team (ConfigCat is a paid hosted service beyond free tier)
You need client-side browser or React-specific feature flag SDKs (this is the Node.js server SDK)
You are starting a new project today (this SDK is in maintenance mode and superseded by configcat/js-unified-sdk)
You need feature flags tightly integrated with product analytics or experimentation platforms
